messages:
nora (design): quick flag from today's hallway test — people were unsure what 'severity' meant on rules. they thought it changes routing priority, but we use a separate priority field. need clearer semantics + UI.
diego (pm): yikes. we should avoid reusing 'severity'. propose rename to 'impact' with tooltip: 'Impact affects how preview scores are weighted, not execution order. Use priority to change routing.' also show a small info pill next to header linking to docs.
emma (frontend): implementation notes: renaming is fine, but we have to migrate persisted field names and keep backward compatibility for existing policies. will add server mapping and a migration shim for the client. also the compact list currently hides the impact chip until hover; maybe show a minimal outline chip always so users can scan.
rachel (a11y): accessibility considerations:
  - chips must have accessible names, e.g., "Impact: high".
  - tooltip must be keyboard-accessible and dismissible with Esc.
  - when we rename, screen readers should announce the new label; include an ARIA live region during the initial render for assistive tech that a label changed for admins.
nora (design): for copy ideas: header text 'Impact (affects preview scoring)' and chip variants Low / Medium / High. Inline help: 'Impact changes scoring used in simulations. Priority determines the order rules are evaluated.'
diego (pm): another thing from tests: preview sampling rate slider confused users. they expected exact token counts. suggest replacing percent-only display with both percent and estimated requests per minute e.g., '5% (~50 req/min)'. also disable slider when there are no snapshots and show a tooltip explaining why.
emma (frontend): ok. will add a small calc based on workspace traffic metric or fall back to global median. when slider disabled show aria-describedby linking to explanation: 'Disabled until a snapshot is selected.'
rachel (a11y): nit: when slider update changes estimated RPS, update a polite live region: 'Sampling set to 5 percent. Estimated 50 requests per minute.' debounce updates to avoid noisy SR announcements.
nora (design): validation levels: we currently only show red errors. propose adding 'warning' (yellow) for non-blocking issues like deprecated matchers. warnings should not prevent simulation but display in the validation summary. UX: show an icon next to rule title and a summary banner: '1 warning, 2 errors' with link to expand list.
diego (pm): product rule: errors block simulation & saving; warnings only block simulation if user opts into 'strict mode' toggle on top of the editor. default strict mode = off. need to surface that toggle clearly.
emma (frontend): plan: optimistic save path unchanged; on save, server returns validation payload with severities. client will render inline markers and banner. for warnings we'll avoid role=alert; use role=status. errors will use role=alert and focus the banner. also add keyboard shortcut focus-to-first-error.
rachel (a11y): agree — errors assertive+focus, warnings polite. for the banner focus, don't steal focus from typing unless save was triggered. ensure keyboard users can navigate from banner to each issue via skip links.
nora (design): reorder affordance: testers missed it in dense mode. proposal: in dense/compact list, increase hit target and add a subtle vertical separator so the handle is visually anchored. show a tooltip on first hover "Drag to reorder (or press space)" and ensure SR-only text always present.
emma (frontend): will implement hit area increase and add roving tabindex with keyboard move patterns. will also include a short aria-live announcement: 'Rule "X" moved to position 3 of 8' — include rule name + position. debounce rapid moves.
diego (pm): decision summary:
  - rename severity -> Impact (nora + emma implement migration shim)
  - show impact chip outline in compact view (emma)
  - sampling slider shows percent + estimated RPM, disabled with explanation when no snapshot (emma + nora)
  - add warnings level and strict-mode toggle (product + frontend)
  - errors use assertive alerts + focus banner; warnings use polite status (rachel)
  - improve reorder hit target and announcements (emma + rachel)
  - owners: nora copy + mockups, emma frontend, rachel a11y sign-off, diego will update spec/tickets
emma (frontend): i'll split into two PRs: 1) rename/migration + chip + reorder hit target, 2) sampling slider + validation banner + strict-mode. each PR will include storybook stories and automated accessibility checks. ETA: PR1 mid-week, PR2 end of sprint.
staging-bot: rolling out feature branch 'feature/routing-impact-refactor' to staging at 2025-09-10T02:30Z.
rachel (a11y): i'll draft checklist for the PRs: tooltip keyboard interactions, live region wording for slider + reorder + migration announcement, focus management for validation banner.
diego (pm): thanks team. i'll update the policy editor RFC and link the tickets. we'll re-run a small usability test after PR2 lands. :rocket:
